## Play: Invest or Wait

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Invest or Wait (10 to 15 min)" icon="false"}
Should a plant spend money now to save money later? Read each project's [cash flow diagram]{.term}, then invest or wait. Your analyst can work out a [payback period]{.term} or a [net present value]{.term}, but there are never enough hours to check everything. Afterwards, compare your choices with the best value at the [MARR]{.term key="minimum-attractive-rate-of-return"} and see where payback alone goes wrong. The game previews [engineering economics]{.term} and the [time value of money]{.term}.

{{< game invest-or-wait title="Invest or Wait" height="900" >}}
:::
